751-1115-3755.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1953-2790.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
1953-2790.notablePrerequisites:
Angel of Destiny must exist on the battlefield as a token.
You control three other tokens that do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block flying creatures you control.
1953-2790.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 blue Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and then causing each other token you control to become a copy of your token Angel of Destiny indefinitely.
Declare all your Angels as attackers, sending at least one Angel at each opponent.
When first strike damage is dealt, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers for each creature that dealt damage.
Resolve each trigger, causing each opponent to gain life equal to X times the damage they took (where X is the number of Angels you control) and you to gain life equal to that combined total.
Repeat steps 4-5 for the normal damage step.
At the beginning of your end step, since your life total is at least 45, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers, causing the player it attacked to lose the game.

4490-6661--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-6661--210.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
4490-6661--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Minwu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink by any method.
Gain life by any method.
Minwu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
4490-6661--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

720-1531-1806-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1531-1806-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

728-2301-3249-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-4506.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-4506.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1987-5913-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-5913-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-5913-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-5913-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

3259-4885-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1445-4871-5231-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5231-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2499-6252-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2499-6252-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

4559-5226-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
4559-5226-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5226-5805-7306.description:

Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

372-3306-7095.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3306-7095.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

232-1235-3277-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Izzet Chronarch.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Izzet Chronarch with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Izzet Chronarch tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.

Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Harvester of Souls.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

3197-5445-6798.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
3197-5445-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
3197-5445-6798.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Beast.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

104-1496-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1496-3197.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3054-5147-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2060-3054-5147-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-3054-5147-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

413-3771-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
413-3771-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
413-3771-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Rogue.
When the Zombie Rogue dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Ebondeath spell. When Ebondeath enters, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
413-3771-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2510-4484-4871-5256-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2510-4484-4871-5256-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2510-4484-4871-5256-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2525-3358-6633.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5231-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.

5231-5972-6054.description:

When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

413-856-2267-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

56-5256-6248-6255.notablePrerequisites:

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Zahur trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-5256-6248-6255.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5412-5478-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.

Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1379-3003-4231-4365-5966.notablePrerequisites: You control enough artifacts to reduce Rory Williams's command tax to 0.
1379-3003-4231-4365-5966.description:

Rory Williams's last ability triggers, exiling it and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Rory Williams to the command zone from exile.
Sacrifice the two Treasure tokens for {W}{U}.
Repeat.

710-997-5617.description:

When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

579-1409-1414-5131.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Muldrotha.

When Muldrotha enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Muldrotha.

Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Conscripted Infantry from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

813-3742-4872.description:

Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages that is tapped and attacking.
Scholar of the Ages enters, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.

261-262-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
261-262-3957.description:

The token ETBs, triggering Suture Priest three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

1283-1645-4456.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Crown of Flames enchanting a creature.
Pay for Talisman to untap Chromatic Orrery.
